comments: 4fe7aadc: Initializes the patch installation process and provides an update message.
0453b589: Prints a blank line for better readability in the output.
cb2c2625: Displays a message indicating the start of the package file update.
a68e5e94: Entry point for updating the PACKAGE file with specific values.
c447bbea: Finds the PACKAGE entry for DGJ using a standard lookup.
85ca6c64: Initializes loop counter and package IEN (Internal Entry Number) variables.
8b4f663f: Iterates through the PACKAGE file entries found.
c0121240: Skips entries that do not match the 'DGJ' package code.
5c4038da: Sets the DGJIEN with the IEN of the matched PACKAGE entry.
b75abf74: Checks if the DGJ package entry was found; if not, aborts the update process.
32573c13: Prints a blank line for formatting before displaying the error message.
89eeea23: Displays an error message indicating no package entry was defined and cannot be updated.
2bd339bb: Begins the process of updating specific fields within the PACKAGE entry identified.
93327bf5: Prepares data to update the SHORT DESCRIPTION field of the PACKAGE file.
61c0b9ae: Commits the update to the SHORT DESCRIPTION field.
e5f1e796: Prints a blank line for readability before the success message.
bef38c6f: Indicates the SHORT DESCRIPTION field update is complete.
2308c39b: Clears the variables used for the update operation.
85463f31: Updates the DESCRIPTION field of the PACKAGE file to empty.
e9c12581: Prints a blank line before indicating the DESCRIPTION field update.
88843148: Indicates the DESCRIPTION field update is complete.
b47067fd: Begins the process of updating the FILE multiple within the PACKAGE entry.
c7273822: Clears and reinitializes variables for FILE field processing.
ba09a69d: Lists entries in the FILE sub-file for the identified PACKAGE entry.
9f5d57c5: Initializes the counter for iterating through FILE entries.
defcc4df: Iterates through the FILE sub-file entries found.
71f78dc5: Sets the FILE IEN variable for the current iteration.
3c9b4e14: Prepares for editing the current FILE entry.
36d78a9b: Deletes the .01 field value (essentially clearing the entry).
219571a8: Iterates through a predefined set of numbers, adding them as new FILE entries.
799505f5: Sets up for adding new entries to the FILE sub-file.
556630f3: Specifies the characteristics for the new FILE entries to be added.
979314bc: Executes the addition of a new entry to the FILE sub-file.
b03a0254: Prints a blank line before indicating the FILE field update.
05748e1a: Indicates the FILE field update is complete.
c7e09535: Starts the process to update specific fields within the FILE entries.
005b14b2: Prepares for accessing the FILE sub-file of the PACKAGE file.
5d18d62a: Sets properties for accessing the FILE sub-file.
e727eebe: Iterates through predefined values, updating fields for each.
768fef05: Executes the field update operation for the current FILE entry.
eb8eac85: Prepares the DIE and DA variables for editing the current FILE entry.
ed4a34c7: Updates fields for the '40.8' entry within the FILE.
8cc1ef4f: Updates fields for the '43' entry within the FILE.
437320ac: Updates a single field for the '405' entry within the FILE.
f59b38be: Sets a specific field value for entries in the '393.x' series within the FILE.
76b155c5: Prints a blank line for readability before the success message.
e210efa9: Indicates the FIELD field update is complete.
9a3eb9a1: Begins the process to update the 'EX' (Exclude) namespace entries.
d4e39f3e: Prepares for adding a new EXCLUDE namespace entry for the package.
e1bee5d5: Sets properties for the EXCLUDE namespace entry to be added.
3906df22: Adds 'DGJZ' as an EXCLUDE namespace entry.
e90d8439: Sets up for checking if the 'REGISTRATION' package is defined.
aee5e5a4: Checks if the 'REGISTRATION' package is found; if not, aborts the update.
ba5f37c5: Displays a message if the 'REGISTRATION' package is not found.
61b8a5dd: Advises contacting PIMS National VISTA Support Team for assistance.
3f62f898: Prepares for adding 'DGJ' as an EXCLUDE namespace entry under 'REGISTRATION'.
67be18f3: Adds 'DGJ' as an EXCLUDE namespace entry.
013a224f: Cleans up variables, preparing to exit the routine.
f71552bd: Marks the end of the routine.
